mentions.name: iShotAPhoto
mentions.description: A web tool that transforms selfies and photos into visa- and document-compliant ID photos. Users take a selfie and pick a document type (e.g., China Visa online, Green Card lottery), and the tool applies the correct size, head height, and shoulders position requirements. Image-based AI (not LLM) detects head position, emotions, objects, and other details to provide better recommendations.
mentions.source_excerpt: An AI (not LLM, but image-based one) based tool which transforms photos into visa compliant photos.

evidence.value: An AI (not LLM, but image-based one) based tool which transforms photos into visa compliant photos.
